content:
The HWPX document generation succeeded by correctly mapping supplier data to XML structures, though reliance on hardcoded template paths requires validation.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 with all tests passing in test_output.py. The system successfully automated the supplier contact sheet generation, but future iterations should verify the robustness of the XML parsing against malformed HWPX inputs. Reusable logic includes the data-to-XML mapping, while hardcoded file paths in the generation script remain a potential point of failure.
